title: Stencil Spray
description: Airbrushed stencils. A whole set of shapes — the card suits (heart, spade, club, diamond), a four-point sparkle and a five-point star, a crescent, a flower, a lightning bolt, a hexagon, a triangle and a teardrop — are each rasterised into a signed distance field, and the spray is a function of that distance: densest right at the stencil edge and feathering outward, so the symbol reads as clean negative space punched out of a cloud of paint drifting over grainy paper. Because real distance fields drive it, any shape dissolves into any other by lerping their fields. The shifter is generic: cycle in order or at random, and morph smoothly or hard-cut between shapes — or pick one by hand. Halo width, spray grain, inside glow, core burn, spin, paint and paper colours are all live, and a beat can bloom the spray so the paint pulses to sound.
